properties.description: An Actions deploy of site/ to GitHub Pages, from main only: on each push to main that touches site/, the workflow or tools/site_counts.py, and on a dispatch, which release.yml's `site` job makes on main once each release is published. It never runs on a tag, because the github-pages environment admits main alone (v0.84.0's tag run was refused, fact:root-cause-a-release-tag-cannot-publish-the-site-because-the-github-pages-environment-admits-main-alone-2026-10-14). It checks out every tag (fetch-depth 0) and writes one file, site/counts.json, with tools/site_counts.py: reflow2's own design counted at each release, for the home page's "It adds up". Nothing else is built (2026-10-14).
properties.name: .github/workflows/pages.yml — publishes site/ to GitHub Pages
